title: Google pays ~$2.7B to license Character.AI tech

sources.quote: As part of the deal, Google paid $2.7 billion to license Character.AI's technology and bring Shazeer back into the fold, The Wall Street Journal noted.
Google wrote Character a check for around $2.7 billion, according to people with knowledge of the deal.

explain: Google paid Character.AI a reported $2.7 billion licensing fee for its chatbot technology and rehired its founders, including Noam Shazeer. Licensing instead of buying let Google skip a full merger review. The amount comes from Wall Street Journal sources, not the companies.
